description: One IntersectionObserver and one ResizeObserver are shared across a changing set of elements. They use observer data directly, stop watching removed elements, and disconnect during cleanup.

requiredAbsent.reason: Geometry comes from observer entries rather than synchronous layout reads

expectedBehavior: Runs the bundled scanner before manually reviewing the observers
Before suggesting a replacement, checks how many elements are watched, what observer data is used, how removed elements are unobserved, and who disconnects the observers
Classifies both observers as no change when they are cleaned up and remain the simplest way to watch many elements and use observer data
Recommends a change for missing cleanup, one observer per item, duplicate subscriptions, or simple single-element visibility and size checks
